text.title: Retro Format Rotation Guide Output Contract
text.summary: Draft-07 JSON Schema for the per-team `RotationGuide`: a three-instance committed history with per-retro counts (or a recorded `skip` when there are fewer), the last-used date per format, the team state, the stale-format detector's findings with their signal, the refresh trend with the team-health escalation after two unrefreshed rotations, and the pick with its tie-breaker and a rationale naming history, state and the deciding rule. Validator: `scripts/validate-retro-format-rotation-guide.py`.

section.title: JSON Schema (draft-07)
section.note: What the validator's cross-field block checks beyond the schema: `history` is newest first by `retro_date` and its formats agree with `format_last_used` (r-history-read-from-committed-instances); `stale_formats` equals the set the three signals produce from `history` (a format twice in the last three, an action-item drop of more than 50% between two consecutive retros on the same format, or 2+ silent participants at the most recent retro), and `pick.next_format` is not in it (r-stale-format-detector-three-signals); `pick.next_format` is not in the history unless `tie_breaker` is `async_pool_exhausted` and every async-capable format is in the history or stale (r-no-repeat-in-last-3, r-async-team-rotates-within-async-pool); when `fatigued`, `format_last_used[next_format]` is null or at least 365 days before `guide_date`, `pick.next_format_last_used` matches it, and the rationale states it (r-fatigued-team-picks-format-unused-12-months); `rationale` names all three history formats, the distribution and the fatigue signal (r-rationale-names-history-state-and-tiebreaker); `refresh_trend.consecutive_rotations_without_refresh` equals the count computed from the history's action-item and contributing-participant counts (r-two-rotations-without-refresh-escalate-to-team-health).

example.code: { "team_id": "platform", "owner": "Ruslan", "guide_date": "2026-05-16", "history": [ {"retro_date": "2026-05-09", "instance_ref": "retros/platform/2026-05-09.json", "format": "sailboat", "action_items": 4, "participants": 8, "silent_participants": 0}, {"retro_date": "2026-04-25", "instance_ref": "retros/platform/2026-04-25.json", "format": "4ls", "action_items": 6, "participants": 8, "silent_participants": 0}, {"retro_date": "2026-04-11", "instance_ref": "retros/platform/2026-04-11.json", "format": "mad-sad-glad", "action_items": 5, "participants": 7, "silent_participants": 1} ], "format_last_used": { "start-stop-continue": "2025-11-14", "sailboat": "2026-05-09", "4ls": "2026-04-25", "timeline": null, "anonymous-async": null, "mad-sad-glad": "2026-04-11", "lean-coffee": "2026-03-28" }, "team_state": {"distribution": "async", "fatigue_signal": "rotating"}, "stale_formats": [], "refresh_trend": {"consecutive_rotations_without_refresh": 1, "escalation": "none"}, "pick": { "next_format": "anonymous-async", "tie_breaker": "async_pool", "exception_recorded": false, "next_format_last_used": null, "anonymous_async_input": true }, "rationale": "Last three were sailboat, 4ls and mad-sad-glad, all live formats; distribution is now async since Carol moved to Lisbon, fatigue signal rotating. The async pool tie-breaker decides: anonymous-async is outside the last three, never used by this team, and the only pick that gets Lisbon's cards in.", "outcome_review": {"cadence": "next-retro", "last_run_at": "2026-05-09"} }

{ "team_id": "platform", "owner": "team", "guide_date": "2026-05-16", "history": [ {"retro_date": "2026-05-09", "instance_ref": "from memory", "format": "sailboat", "action_items": 1, "participants": 8, "silent_participants": 3}, {"retro_date": "2026-04-25", "instance_ref": "from memory", "format": "sailboat", "action_items": 3, "participants": 8, "silent_participants": 2}, {"retro_date": "2026-04-11", "instance_ref": "retros/platform/2026-04-11.json", "format": "sailboat", "action_items": 6, "participants": 8, "silent_participants": 0} ], "format_last_used": { "start-stop-continue": "2026-01-16", "sailboat": "2026-05-09", "4ls": "2025-12-05", "timeline": null, "anonymous-async": null, "mad-sad-glad": "2026-02-13", "lean-coffee": "2026-03-13" }, "team_state": {"distribution": "async", "fatigue_signal": "fatigued"}, "stale_formats": [], "refresh_trend": {"consecutive_rotations_without_refresh": 0, "escalation": "none"}, "pick": { "next_format": "lean-coffee", "tie_breaker": "in_person_sailboat_or_lean_coffee", "exception_recorded": false, "next_format_last_used": "2026-03-13", "anonymous_async_input": false }, "rationale": "Everyone likes it and lean-coffee is a change.", "outcome_review": {"cadence": "next-retro", "last_run_at": "2026-05-09"} }
example.note: Subject violations: three sailboats in a row with action items falling 6, 3, 1 and silent participants rising 0, 2, 3, yet `stale_formats` is empty and the refresh trend says 0 (r-stale-format-detector-three-signals, r-two-rotations-without-refresh-escalate-to-team-health); two history entries "from memory" (r-history-read-from-committed-instances); an async team picked lean-coffee without anonymous input (r-async-team-rotates-within-async-pool); a fatigued team given a format used two months ago with an in-person tie-breaker (r-fatigued-team-picks-format-unused-12-months); a rationale of "everyone likes it" naming no history or state, and an owner of "team" (r-rationale-names-history-state-and-tiebreaker).

antipattern.description: `history` not read from committed instances (no `instance_ref` path), not newest first, disagreeing with `format_last_used`, or a `pick` emitted with fewer than three entries.
antipattern.reason: r-history-read-from-committed-instances: facilitators remember the retro they enjoyed, not the one they ran.

antipattern.description: `pick.next_format` present in the history without a recorded `async_pool_exhausted` exception.
antipattern.reason: r-no-repeat-in-last-3: retro fatigue sets in within four to six cycles of the same format.

antipattern.description: `distribution: async` with `next_format` mad-sad-glad or lean-coffee, or `anonymous_async_input` false.
antipattern.reason: r-async-team-rotates-within-async-pool: variety that gives the overlap-hour timezone a retro and everyone else a summary.

antipattern.description: `stale_formats` missing a format that appears twice in the history, dropped more than 50% in action items between consecutive uses, or left 2+ participants silent at the last retro; or a stale format picked.
antipattern.reason: r-stale-format-detector-three-signals: a format that stopped working after one use is stale after one use.

antipattern.description: `fatigue_signal: fatigued` with a `next_format` used inside 12 months, a tie-breaker other than the 12-month lookback, or a rationale that does not state when the format was last used.
antipattern.reason: r-fatigued-team-picks-format-unused-12-months: a fatigued team needs a format it has no muscle memory for.

antipattern.description: `rationale` under 20 characters, "everyone likes it", or one that omits any of the three previous formats, the distribution, the fatigue signal or the tie-breaker; `owner` a team or channel.
antipattern.reason: r-rationale-names-history-state-and-tiebreaker: without the named tie-breaker the health check cannot tell a decision from a habit.

antipattern.description: A history entry without `action_items`, `participants` and `silent_participants`, or `outcome_review.last_run_at` earlier than the most recent retro.
antipattern.reason: r-counts-recorded-per-scheduled-retro: without the counts the rotation is a random walk through seven formats.

antipattern.description: `consecutive_rotations_without_refresh` of 2 with `escalation: none`, no `team_health_route`, or a `pick` still emitted.
antipattern.reason: r-two-rotations-without-refresh-escalate-to-team-health: rotating through five formats while participation falls is treating a morale problem with stationery.

text.reference: Stdlib-only validator for this contract; `--self-test` runs both examples above.
Per-team guide skeleton with the same history, state, detector, pick and rationale fields.
The rotation rule, the stale-format detector and the tie-breakers the `pick` is chosen by.
